intro: Wildmane Cleansing marks the culmination of the tauren ritual efforts to purify the vital watering holes of Mulgore. Entrusted by Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village, heroes take the completed Wildmane Totem north to cleanse the final poisoned well. Driving back goblin pollutants restores balance to the plains and secures the pastoral livelihood of the tauren tribes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young friend. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.
The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The last water well remains fetid and poisonous, friend. You must not delay!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, friend.
May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
